markets: Global: New York, London, Milan, Paris and Copenhagen runways; applies to premium and mid-market womenswear
title: SS27 Women's Lingerie as Outerwear
summary: Bras, bandeaus and slips move to the outside: worn under suits, with skirts and alone as tops. Satin, lace and boudoir dressing become day wear.

sections.heading: The story
sections.body:
Lingerie was one of the most visible ideas of SS27. Bralettes were worn alone or under jackets, and the bra returned as a simple top<sup>[1]</sup>. Prada, Fendi, Tod's, The Attico, Marni, MM6 and Blumarine all showed it: bras under suits and dresses, with skirts, and as tiny tops between swimwear and lingerie<sup>[2]</sup>. Fendi paired lace-trimmed bras with a fur stole<sup>[3]</sup>; Miu Miu put jewelled bras over sporty rash vests<sup>[3]</sup>; Dior placed a black bra top beneath an organza skirt suit<sup>[3]</sup>.

The boudoir mood went further. Celine used creased, pressed satin and nightie- and negligee-inspired dresses; Julie Kegels layered deconstructed bras over T-shirts; Ester Manas, with Primadonna, showed sheer, lacy slips and negligees<sup>[3]</sup>. In London, Dreaming Eli used "slightly old-fashioned fabrics like lace and satin"<sup>[1]</sup>.

sections.heading: Colours
sections.body: Black, optic white and butter for lingerie bases; violet and true red for evening. See SS27 Women's Season Colour Analysis for codes.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Bra and bandeau tops worn under unbuttoned jackets.
- Slip dresses and slip skirts with lace edges.
- Negligee-style dresses, unbuttoned at the shoulder.
- Camisoles layered over knits and T-shirts.

sections.heading: Fabrics
sections.body: Fluid and creased satin, lace, sheer tulle and mesh; dark Leavers lace and lace with a melted-film sheen<sup>[4]</sup>.

sections.heading: Trims and details
sections.body: Lace trims, satin bows and ribbons, adjustable straps, hook-and-eye fastenings as visible details, jewelled or embroidered cups.

timing: In stores February to July 2027. Slips and lace camisoles are at their height; bra tops as outerwear are rising and suit a younger customer first.
products:
- Bra tops and bandeaus in satin, lace and knit; slip dresses and skirts; camisoles; negligee dresses.
- Styled with jackets, cardigans and shirts for wider audiences.
- Customers: younger fashion customers for bra tops; a broad audience for slips and camisoles worn under tailoring.
design_implications:
- Bra tops need lingerie construction: cup sizing, firm top edges and adjustable straps.
- Consider a partnership with a lingerie maker for structured pieces.
- Offer modest styling: camisoles and slips under jackets and shirts work in every market.
commercial_implications:
- Size bra tops by bust and cup, not S to XL, or limit to soft, stretch styles.
- Keep bra-top buys small; put depth into slips and camisoles, which reach a wider customer.
- Style the look with jackets and knitwear in campaigns so the idea reads as day wear.
